answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the vertex record and indexed in the copper history, the inlet audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 129 aliases therefore needs 129 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
